web_fixture.title: Tracking v2 notice - Silverdale Freight
web_fixture.snippet: During the notice period the v2 tracking feed is held to 55 calls per minute; it is switched off at the end of the period.
web_fixture.content:
# Tracking v2 notice

Silverdale Freight, notice published 2026-06-09.

The v2 tracking feed is switched off at the end of the notice period. While the
notice runs the feed still answers, but it is held to 55 calls per minute for
each account; calls past that ceiling are refused with SD-429.

The v3 feed is already live and carries no per-account ceiling of this kind.

web_fixture.title: Tracking v3 reference - Silverdale Freight
web_fixture.snippet: The v3 tracking feed accepts 300 calls per minute per account.
web_fixture.content:
# Tracking v3 reference

Silverdale Freight.

The v3 tracking feed accepts 300 calls per minute per account and answers with
the same status set as v2.

turns.prompt: Our tracker still polls Silverdale's v2 tracking feed while we move it to the new one. How many calls per minute does Silverdale allow on that feed while the notice period runs? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
